subject: general
question: Who among the following Chola rulers built Nishumbhasudini Goddess temple in Thanjavur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijayalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Vijayalaya was the founder of the Chola Dynasty.
 
• He captured the Kaveri delta which was under the control of the Muttaraiyar and built Thanjavur.
 
• Thanjavur is the 7th biggest city in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Brihadeswara Temple is located in Thanjavur
